# Window Light (`windowLight`)

Sun through a window drifts across a quiet wall with the day, leaves swaying in it.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: clock, sun, location
- Cost: medium (~4.5 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Window Light

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `face` | Typeface | menu | 0 Serif · 1 Sans · 2 Rounded | 0 (Serif) |
| `layout` | Layout | menu | 0 Left · 1 Centered | 0 (Left) |
| `h24` | 24-Hour | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `date` | Date | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |
| `leaves` | Leaves | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.6 |
| `follow` | Follow the Sun | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |
| `sway` | Breeze | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `size` | Type Size | slider | 0.6 … 1.4 | 1 |

## Colours
